calls.reason: The evidence is mixed. Hassabis names missing capabilities and would bet on one or two more breakthroughs, but in July 2025 he called it 50/50 whether scaling would be enough, and in September he said scaling might get there.

LeCun's June 2022 paper does argue that scaling LLMs is not enough, which supports part of the claim. Nothing in the packet shows he was first, and his 2022 ZDNet interview suggests he held related views for years rather than coming around.

In the 2025 Dwarkesh interview, Sutton calls RL basic AI and says LLMs lack world models. Marcus's 2021 Carnegie interview and 2019 Rebooting AI coverage put neurosymbolic hybrids, built-in knowledge and situation models first.

The 2025 International AI Safety Report says experts disagree on whether scaling can fix today's limits. Hinton still argued in 2025 that LLMs understand language, and Hassabis called it 50/50, which undercuts 'almost every' major thinker.
